notes: The manual gives two alternative circuits (potentiometer OR 10k photoresistor + 10k resistor). The potentiometer circuit, which the text describes, is modelled. Photoresistor variant: 5V wire to one photoresistor leg, 10k resistor from the other leg to GND, A0 wire at the junction of the two.

In the images the breadboard's top half is labelled rows f-j and the bottom half a-e, so image bottom half maps to catalogue bank 't' and the image top half maps to bank 'b'. The pot's outer legs are in 10t.e and 12t.e, and its middle (wiper) leg sticks up to 11b.f.
Which outer pot leg goes to GND vs 5V is symmetric; black wire to the left leg (col 10), red to the right (col 12) as in the image.

The external LED circuit (220 ohm resistor and red LED on pin 13) is optional and has no image. Its breadboard placement (columns 20-25 in the f-j half) is assumed. The cathode goes to the GND pin next to pin 13, assumed to be GND.3 in the catalogue. The power-header GND in the image is mapped to GND.1.
Wire colours of the optional LED wires are assumed.
